main_text.p: [illegible, ~5 letters] apud Maronitas id est princeps sacerdotum, designatur Episcopu verbum [illegible, ~3 letters] quod passim quoque occurrit, significat, versiculum repetendum esse, & est à verbo [illegible, ~3 letters] repetit, iter vit,[?]

VIII. Quæris an Presbyteri, & Episcopi Maronitæ Romam venientes Missa celebrent in collegio suo more ac lingu sua, uti Græci in collegio suo & æqu fruantur privilegio. Respondeo, Maronitas non modo in suo collegio sacro celebrare more & lingua sua, sed etiam quandoque extra collegium, quod ab facile non permittitur.

IX. Quæris an viri conjugati Diaconatui & Sacerdotio initiantur? Respondeo, omnino, sed non ita ut cœlibes his ordinibus arceantur, uti & apud [?] aliquos Orientales mos est, imo ipso exemplo Apostoli summopere laudantur. De hoc argumento multa mihi dicendi essent contra nostri temporis hæreticorum latratus.

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of lines, so many words are incomplete (for example "Episcopu", "lingv", "æqu", "ꝛ"). These are copied as far as they are visible and not completed. The Syriac words at the start of the first line, in the middle of line three, and in the last clause of the first paragraph are not legible enough to copy, so they are marked illegible. The reading "iter vit," at the end of the first paragraph is doubtful. The "X.Qva" paragraph is cut off by the edge of the scan.
